maria (Marketing): Hey runtime team — we need a quick verification pass on the latency & cold-start numbers we're quoting for the launch post. The doc has the claims and the sample set link: https://redwood.internal/launch/claims-2026. Can you 1) spot-check quantized variants, 2) run coldstart heatmap (first 1k reqs), and 3) confirm sample provenance (are these synthetic or live anonymized?). Need a short sign-off + raw outputs for the press kit by EOD Fri.

alex (eng/runtime): Which model variants are we claiming? quant-4bit, int8, or fp16? Also do you want p50/p95/p99 or just p95 + coldstart tail?

maria (Marketing): We're calling out fp16 baseline and a "quantized" number in the table (we planned to use 4-bit QAT numbers). For metrics, p95 and a coldstart heatmap are enough. Keep p50 for internal context.

sam (eng/runtime): Ok — we'll do quant-4bit (QAT) + fp16. Quick checklist for you: remove any PII from samples (we only accept the sanitized s3 path), and confirm target SLO (is p95 <= 120ms for the demo?).

maria (Marketing): Yes p95 <= 120ms is the claim for the demo page. Samples are sanitized already — path: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/samples_v2_sanitized.json. Please include the exact CLI commands and the raw CSVs we can attach to the PR.

alex (eng/runtime): Got it. We'll run a coldstart sweep + 3 warmup configs (none, short 50 reqs, full 500 reqs). Running nightly smoke now. Command we will use:
```
./run_bench --model rwd-13b-fp16 --quant q4_k_m --samples s3://redwood-marketing/launch/samples_v2_sanitized.json --out /tmp/launch_checks --warmup 0,50,500 --concurrency 4 --metrics csv,json
```
We'll also snapshot the first-req latencies for the heatmap.

runtime-bot: smoke job started: job_id=rb-smoke-9812, ETA ~18m. Logs: https://internal.logs/redwood/jobs/rb-smoke-9812

jen (Product): If the quant numbers are within 10% of fp16 p95 we can use the headline. If not, we'll need to adjust wording to "up to Xx cheaper with quantized variants". Also please flag any bursty tail issues.

sam (eng/runtime): Noted. Acceptance: quant p95 <= fp16_p95 * 1.10 AND coldstart p95 <= 150ms. We'll include raw CSVs for each warmup slice and a short README for provenance.

alex (eng/runtime): Quick ask — marketing to confirm which two example prompts must appear in the PR so we can ensure they're included verbatim in the sample pack. We avoid any prompts with sensitive tokens.

maria (Marketing): Example prompts: 1) "Summarize this developer doc in 3 bullets" 2) "Rewrite this SQL query for readability" — both in sanitized set. We're good.

runtime-bot: smoke job completed: job_id=rb-smoke-9812, results s3://redwood-internal/bench/rb-smoke-9812/results.zip

alex (eng/runtime): Initial pass: fp16 p95=98ms, quant-4bit p95=112ms (within 14%), coldstart p95=138ms (full warmup helped). Raw CSVs uploaded to the path above. I'll run a focused rerun with cache-enabled and a model-variant fallback to collect the per-token breakdown if you want cost mapping.

maria (Marketing): Thanks — can you include a brief one-paragraph note on sample origins (sanitized user queries vs synthetic) we can paste in the press appendix? Also confirm we can use the quant number as our highlighted stat if we reword slightly ("~14% increase in p95 vs fp16; still under 120ms").

sam (eng/runtime): We'll add a provenance note: "Samples are anonymized user queries drawn from opt-in telemetry, sanitized and filtered for sensitive info; synthetic prompts were used only for rare corner-cases." We'll also provide the per-token cost CSV.

alex (eng/runtime): Final deliverables we'll attach: 1) raw CSVs for each warmup slice, 2) heatmap PNG, 3) provenance note, 4) CLI commands + exact git commit of bench infra. ETA: EOD Fri.

maria (Marketing): Perfect — thanks! :raised_hands: Ping us here when uploads are ready and we'll pull artifacts into the press kit."
